page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left page with a main column of Greek-Latin glossary entries, and right page with a narrow marginal column of notes along the right edge (partly cropped). Left page: running head centred above text, page number top left. Right page: narrow column of marginal notes at its left and right edges, printed in small type.

main_text.p: Χειρόγραφον ἡ τὸ chirographum, syngrapha. q.d. χειρὶ γεγραμμένον, manu propria scriptum.
Χειροποίητος ὁ ἡ manu factus a. q.d. τῇ χειρὶ ποιητός.

Χειροτονέω ῶ per suffragia creo. q.d. χεῖρα τείνω, manum protendo, protensa manu eligo. Solebant enim protensa manu suffragium & sententiam ferre. Fut. χειροτονήσω. P. κεχειροτόνηκα. a.1. act. ἐχειροτόνησα. a.1. pass. ἐχειροτονήθην ης ή. Confer ἀποχειροτονέω ῶ.
Χείρων ον ὁ ἡ pejor, deterior. Positivus ejus χερείων ἡ ον malus a um.
Χήρ ὁ ὁ viduus. Χήρα ας ἡ vidua, 1 Timoth. 5. v. 5.
Χθὲς heri, Adv. ὁ χθὲς scil. ἡμέρα hesternus.
Χιλίαρχος ου ὁ militum tribunus, ein oberster.
Χιτὼν ῶνος ὁ tunica. Ionice κιθών.
Χιὼν όνος ἡ nix, χιόνος τὸ χιών.
Χλαμὺς ύδος ἡ chlamys ydis g.f. & chlamida a ein ritterkleid oder kriegsmantel.

Χλευάζω cavillor, exsibilo, ludificor (ἀπὸ χλευῆς ἡ risus, illusio, cavillum, quasi χλεύη, quod peragatur labiis.) imperf. ἐχλεύαζον. F. χλευάσω. P. κεχλεύακα. prat. pass. κεχλεύασμαι. unde χλευαστὴς ὁ cavillator, irrisor.
Χλιαρὸς ά όν tepidus a um. ἀπὸ χλιαίνω tepefacio. F. χλιανῶ. P. κεχλίαγκα.
Χλωρὸς ά όν viridis e, χλωρὸς χόρτος viride gramen.

page.notes: Right-hand page is cropped and largely illegible; its marginal notes were not transcribed. Greek accents and some abbreviations are approximate. Left-hand running head read as printed.
